about_the_game:
Fullsenders is a 1-4 player co-op movement FPS based in a beautiful procedurally generated world that is fighting an AI threat, the only way to discover the secrets and loot is to full send and find out.

PLAY SOLO OR CO-OP WITH 1-4 PLAYERS

Grab your boys (and girls) and explore, and work together to push through the world and all the threats within whilst communicating through proximity chat

A WHOLE ARSENAL OF WEAPONS

Fullsenders carry a primary weapon, a sidearm and a melee weapon and there are lots of each to discover, collect and master all with original recoil patterns and sprays and designs how ever you like to shoot we have got a weapon for you. 

CLEAN, PRECISE, UNRESTRICTED MOVEMENT

Movement is key to being a top Fullsender and evading enemy fire by using mechanics such as jumping, dashing, sliding, and climbing to build momentum then use that to kick off walls, bhop and air strafe all whilst having access to your weapons... Get creative with it.

BEAUTIFUL PROCEDURALLY GENERATED WORLD

Explore stunning original stylized Battle Royale sized maps where everything changes from the trees and rocks to the POI's and monuments, keeping every run interesting and fresh all running on a day and night cycle.

UNLOCK PERMENANT COSMETICS 

Put your credit card away and lock in as you use skill to earn original skins, headwear and melee weapons to collect and drip out your character from a paper bag hat and wooden spoon melee all the way to that endgame look and an iconic Karambit.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen R5 1600 processor
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 580
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 processor
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
